content: Clinical trials are currently being conducted to further investigate the efficacy of teplizumab and other pharmacologic interventions in delaying the onset of symptomatic type 1 diabetes in individuals who exhibit autoimmune markers and are at high risk of disease progression. It is critical to perform individualized risk assessments, as the response to preventive strategies can differ significantly between individuals. The overarching aim is to develop and provide personalized recommendations that are specifically tailored to an individual’s unique risk profile, thereby maximizing the potential to delay the onset or progression of type 1 diabetes.
